speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds very concerning; tell me, have you noticed any dark urine, yellowing of the skin or eyes, or bone pain that feels worse at night? Also, has anyone in your family recently been diagnosed with similar symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; the bone pain worsening at night is a critical detail. Given her age and symptoms of fever, bruising, and leg pain, have you noticed any swollen lymph nodes or a recent viral illness? Also, what is her current weight and appetite?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue and easy bruising. I also have Fever, Severe leg pain that disturbs sleep.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count (CBC) with differential and Peripheral Blood Smear.
REQUEST TEST: Erythrocyte Sedimentation Rate (ESR) and C-Reactive Protein (CRP).
DIAGNOSIS READY: Leukemia (Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia)
